title: DetectionRecord
description: A single labeled, posed observation of one LED in one frame. See design doc §7.4.

tCaptureMs.description: Phone monotonic clock at frame capture, in milliseconds.

u.description: Sub-pixel centroid x in image coords (origin top-left).

v.description: Sub-pixel centroid y in image coords (origin top-left).

imgW.description: Image width in pixels for this frame.

imgH.description: Image height in pixels for this frame.

K.description: Camera intrinsics for this frame: [fx, fy, cx, cy].

pose.description: Camera pose in the capture session reference space, or null when the capture path has no pose source (the WebXR-free path, docs/vio-exploration.md): pose-less records are solved jointly with the camera trajectory by the visual-inertial reconstructor, which requires the session to carry imu_batch samples.

p.description: Camera position [x, y, z] in meters.

q.description: Camera orientation quaternion [x, y, z, w].

confidence.description: Decoder confidence in [0, 1] from bit margins and blob quality.
